description: Unit tests for the AgentWorkspace component in the OpenClaw project, testing functions related to workspace path display, URL resolution, agents file management, bootstrap initialization, safety checks, and bootstrap necessity assessment.

classes.name: AgentWorkspaceTests
classes.description: Test suite for the AgentWorkspace utility functions, verifying correct handling of workspace paths, bootstrap procedures, and safety checks.

methods.name: `display path uses tilde for home`
methods.description: Tests that the displayPath function correctly replaces the home directory path with a tilde (~).

methods.name: `resolve workspace URL expands tilde`
methods.description: Verifies that resolveWorkspaceURL correctly expands a tilde path to an absolute URL.

methods.name: `agents URL appends filename`
methods.description: Checks that agentsURL appends the correct filename to the workspace URL.

methods.name: `bootstrap creates agents file when missing`
methods.description: Ensures that bootstrap generates the agents file and associated identity, user, and bootstrap files if they do not exist.

methods.name: `bootstrap safety rejects non empty folder without agents`
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrapSafety correctly rejects directories that contain files but lack an agents file.

methods.name: `bootstrap safety allows existing agents file`
methods.description: Ensures bootstrapSafety permits directories that already contain an agents file.

methods.name: `bootstrap skips bootstrap file when workspace has content`
methods.description: Checks that bootstrap does not overwrite the bootstrap file if the workspace contains other files.

methods.name: `needs bootstrap false when identity already set`
methods.description: Verifies that the function correctly determines bootstrap is not needed if the identity file exists and has content.
